tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ All 6 judge failures resolved: memory gate in checkIdle, PeakRSSBytes populated from sandbox.Sampler, GET /metrics endpoint, Observer constructed in main.go, tests pass, over-budget alert fires: All 6 sub-items verified. (1) Memory gate: internal/cron/loop.go:389-437 checkIdle runs MemoryProbe when MemoryThreshold>=0, sets skipReason 'memory'/'load+memory', returns ErrNoIdle; internal/cron/memgate.go implements probeMeminfo/parseMeminfo (UsedFraction = 1 - MemAvailable/MemTotal, DefaultMemFraction=0.9); ResolveConfig loop.go:228-231 defaults MemoryProbe=probeMeminfo; main.go:178 wires MemoryThreshold:*cfg.memFraction (flag default cron.DefaultMemFraction, main.go:334). Tests TestCheckIdleMemoryGateTrips/LoadAndMemoryComposite/HealthyCarriesMemoryReading/MemProbeErrorProceeds/MemoryDisabled all PASS. (2) PeakRSSBytes: internal/sandbox/sampler.go Sampler interface + ProcSampler reads VmHWM from /proc/<pid>/status; loop.go:168 Config.RSSSampler, ResolveConfig:228-229 defaults sandbox.ProcSampler{}; loop.go:461 startRSSTracker(l.cfg.RSSSampler), peakRSS:=tracker.Stop(), record() sets PeakRSSBytes:peakRSS (loop.go:479); rsspoll.go walks /proc/<pid>/task/<pid>/children. Tests TestLoopRecordsPeakRSSFromSampler/TestRSSTrackerStopsAndReturnsMax/TestRSSTrackerLiveProcSelf/TestSolveFailureLogCarriesPeakRSS PASS. (3) GET /metrics: internal/api/server.go:108 mux.HandleFunc("GET /metrics", s.handleMetrics), handleMetrics:225-233 returns Snapshot JSON 200 (404 metrics_disabled when nil); main.go:220-222 router explicitly dispatches /metrics. LIVE VERIFIED: built ./cmd/off-by-one, ran with --skip-sandbox on port 18999, `curl /metrics` -> HTTP=200 {"solve_count":0,"skipped_host_pressure":0,"over_budget":0,"peak_rss_bytes_max":0,"alert_threshold_bytes":4294967296}. Tests TestHandleMetricsReturnsSnapshot/EmptyObserver/NilObserver/MetricsRouterDispatch PASS. (4) Observer in main.go: main.go:163 `observer := metrics.New(metrics.DefaultRSSAlertBytes, log.Default())` constructed UNCONDITIONALLY (outside the solverExec!=nil block), wired to cron loop (main.go:181 Observer:observer) and API server (main.go:203 apiServer.Observer=observer); the live --skip-sandbox run (no solver) still served /metrics 200, proving unconditional construction. (5) Tests pass: `go test ./... -short -p 1 -count=1 -timeout 300s` exit 0, all 15 packages ok (cmd/off-by-one, internal/api, internal/cron, internal/metrics, internal/sandbox, internal/solver, internal/web, ...); `go build ./...` exit 0; `go vet ./...` exit 0; `gofmt -l cmd/ internal/ pkg/ sql/` empty; read_lsp_diagnostics count=0. (6) Over-budget alert: metrics.go RecordSolve logs 'ERROR solve ALERT: peak RSS %d ... exceeds %d' when PeakRSSBytes>alertBytes; TestRecordSolveOverBudget PASS (asserts 'solve ALERT' + 'peak RSS 5368709120'); TestSnapshotOverBudget PASS with live output 'ERROR solve ALERT: peak RSS 5368709120 (5.0 GiB) exceeds 4294967296 (4.0 GiB)'; TestLoopRecordsPeakRSSFromSampler emits the ALERT line end-to-end through the cron loop. The pre-screen's 'wiring missing from real entry point' claim is contradicted by the live binary run. [resolution 0.27; main.go]
All 6 judge failures are resolved and verified with passing tests plus a live end-to-end run of the real binary confirming GET /metrics returns 200 JSON and the over-budget ALERT fires.
